scope: Theorem 1.1 (Donovan’s conjecture) of the manuscript “Donovan's Conjecture over Algebraically Closed Fields” (preprints/Donovans-Conjecture-over-Algebraic-Closures-of-Prime-Fields-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 203 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 80d721e72d29a9bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a prime p, an algebraically closed field K of character- istic p, and a positive integer M. As G ranges over finite groups and b over block idempotents of KG with defect groups of order at most M, only finitely many K-linear Morita equivalence classes of KGb occur. In particular, over this field K, Donovan’s conjecture holds for every finite p-group, including nonabelian groups.
